Card Q&A.a: No, you reduce its memory cost by 3 based on the total number of Digimon and Tamer cards your opponent has in play. For example, if your opponent has 2 Digimon and 1 Tamer, this adds up to 3 cards total, which means you get to reduce the play cost by 9.
Card Q&A.q: When playing this card, do I reduce its memory cost by 3 for each pair of Digimon and Tamer cards my opponent has in play?

Effect: When this card would be played, reduce the play cost by 3 for each of your opponent's Digimon and Tamers.
[On Play][When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete all of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
[End of Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
